data.name: Safdarun
data.long_meaning: Safdarun is a name of Arabic and Urdu origin meaning 'Protector of the Faith'. It is derived from the Arabic words 'Safdar' meaning 'protector' and 'un' meaning 'faith'. This name signifies one who safeguards and upholds the religious beliefs and values.
data.spiritual_meaning: Safdarun is a sacred name in Islam, signifying one who is a protector of the faith and upholds its values. It is a name that inspires a sense of peace, security, and strength.
